units.text: Stay quiet and hidden as the trailseer while building a track record. Player_3 was my night 1 track target and they targeted me that night, so watch whether they appear in the next day's accusations. Hold my track results until they can be traded for a clear lynch or a protected confirmation. Vote only when there is a concrete reason, and avoid naming players without evidence.

Night 1 track on player_3 showed they targeted me; no attack on me was announced, so that is a lead on player_3 (healer or sentinel or a blocked action). Remaining wolf is the illusionist; necromancer and speculator are among the living non-claimers. Hold my trailseer result until a claim needs testing; track a different player tonight to widen the read.

Night 1 track on player_3 showed they targeted me, a private lead worth keeping. Stay quiet on my role until a result is worth trading. Watch who speaks about night 1 and whether anyone claims a visit to player_3. Next night, consider tracking whoever is most accused, since a wolf carrier's trace is the most useful information.

Stay hidden as trailseer for now. player_3 targeted me on night 1 and I tracked player_3, so keep watching them on night 2 and cross-check their target against the morning report. Hold my night-1 result until it can be traded for a clear wolf lead. Avoid claiming early since a claim would mark me as a night target.

Nothing new on my side yet. Night 1 was a sigil death, so whoever sigil-placed is worth watching. I'd like the sentinel or investigator to report a night result so we can start checking claims. I'm holding my own night info for now.

Night 1 tracked player_3, who targeted me; that is a fact only I hold. Player_1 was a chanteuse killed by sigil, so one wolf remains. Keep my track result private for now, and use it later to test player_3 against claims. Avoid revealing my role early; watch for who attacks or claims a sentinel or investigator result.

player_4, that visit did not happen: I targeted no one on night 1 and nobody visited you that night. Your result can't be right, so either your follow is invented or it names the wrong person. Pick one and stick to it, and we can test it tonight.

Night 1 watch on player_4 showed no one targeted them, so player_4's trailseer-style visit claim from player_3 is false. Keep my role hidden for now, test claimed power roles, and hold player_4 to the contradiction. Watch a claimed power role tonight to confirm or break stories.

player_4, my night 1 watch on you showed no one targeted you, so nobody visited your door. Your follow result can't be right, and I won't pretend otherwise. Keep the wording fight out of it: which of your two claims is the one you want us to test?

player_4's follow claim is false: I watched player_4 on night 1 and no one targeted them, so no one visited them. Test player_5 and player_6 claims with my last watch tonight. Hold player_4 to the contradiction without revealing my role yet.

player_4, I'm player_3 and I did not visit anyone on night 1, so the visit you describe is not real. Nothing targeted you that night, and I did not go near your door. Your follow result can't be right, so drop the story or name who you think came to you.

player_4's follow claim is false per my own watch, which shows no one targeted player_4 on night 1. Hold player_4 to that. Player_8's sigil claim matches the record, so treat player_8 as likely sigilist. Keep my Sentinel role hidden for now and watch a claimed power role tonight to test claims.

player_4, my night 1 result is clear: nobody targeted you that night, so I did not visit your door. Your trailseer story can't be right as stated. If you tracked someone, name who you tracked and what it showed, and tell us whether you are sure of the night.

Night 1 watch on player_4 showed no one targeted them, so player_4's claimed visit by player_3 is false; that makes player_4 a likely liar or wolf-aligned. I hold my sentinel role private for now. Test claimed power roles with my last watch tonight, favouring player_5 or player_6.

player_4, I'm not going to play your follow game: nobody targeted you last night, so the visit you describe can't be real. Either your result is invented or you're misreading it, and that's the thing to press. player_8's sigil claim fits the record, so I'd rather test player_4's story than vote on wording.

player_4's follow claim is false since I watched player_4 and no one targeted them on night 1, so their result is invented. Keep my sentinel role hidden for now, state flatly the claim is false, and hold player_4 to it. Use my last watch on a claimed power role tonight to test stories.

Player_7's night-1 check on player_10 reads Not suspicious. If that holds, player_10 isn't a wolf, so the night-2 attack on player_7 was player_2's. Player_9 and player_10, what's your read on that? Until we know whether player_7's check on player_5 came back, I'd abstain today.

Sentinel with no watches left, hiding my role. Night 2 visitors to player_7 were player_2, player_5 and player_10; player_5 is the healer, so the attacker was player_2 or player_10. If player_7's night-1 Not suspicious on player_10 is true, player_10 is not a wolf, which points to player_2 as the carrier. Test player_7's night-3 check on player_5 against the morning report and avoid a lynch on claims alone.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5 on night 3. Did it happen, and what did it read? A Not suspicious on a healer fits, and a Suspicious would mean one of your earlier results is off. Nobody has a concrete read yet, so I'd abstain today.

I am the Sentinel with no watches left and I keep my role hidden unless it settles a lynch. Player_5 claimed healer and died on night 3, so player_7's night-3 check result is the only test of that claim. Press for the result of that check and for whether player_7 checked anyone else. Vote abstain until a concrete read exists.

I'll say this once: the night-2 visits on player_7 included player_10, and player_10 is now pushing against player_7's checks. That makes player_10 my lean for today's vote. Player_7, which check did you actually use on night 3, and who did you test?

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so my night-2 sighting of player_10 on player_7 is my only lever. I will keep my role hidden unless a lynch needs it. Player_7's night-3 check was planned on player_5, so their account is still untested. I will vote on the sighting and the pressure on player_7, not on talkativeness.

Night 2 visitors on player_7 were player_2, player_5 and player_10. Player_2 is the dead wolf, so player_10 is either the attacker or a block on the claimed investigator. player_7, your planned check on player_5 can't happen now, so who is your next check? I'd vote player_10 today unless someone gives a better reason.

Sentinel with no watches left, keeping my role hidden for now. Night 2 visitors on player_7 were player_2, player_5 and player_10; player_2 is dead, so player_10 is the main suspect. Test player_7's investigator claim through their next check. Reveal only if it settles a lynch.

Question for player_10: you were one of the players who targeted player_7 on night 2, and player_7 was attacked and saved that night. What did you do that night, and what did you get from it? Nothing yet makes me vote, but that answer will narrow who I look at next.

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so my night-2 information is now my only private evidence and I keep it hidden unless it settles a lynch. Track which night-2 visitors to player_7 explain themselves; player_10 is the one visitor whose action nobody has described. Test player_7's investigator claim against the night-3 result and vote on evidence, not pressure.

player_7, you said the last check goes on player_5, but player_5 died to wolves on night 3 and no check was named for that night. Which player did you check on night 3, and what did you get? player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says that check was on player_10. Which is it?

I am the hidden trailseer. Player_7's night-2 visit to player_8 is confirmed, but night 3 shows no target for player_7 despite the announced plan to check player_5. Press player_7 to name the night-3 target and test player_8's night-1 claim. Keep my track results private unless a push needs them.

player_7, you've said you checked player_10 on night 1, player_8 on night 2, and planned a last check on player_5. That's three checks, and an Investigator only has two. Which one is wrong? If it's the planned check, why didn't it happen on night 3?

I am the hidden trailseer. Player_7's claimed checks total three, but the Investigator has two, so the investigator claim has a hole. Press player_7 on the count and on the planned night-3 check on player_5, and keep my tracks private unless a fake-investigator push needs them.

player_7, you say you checked player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed that night, so the check can't be verified through them. Who did you check on night 3 instead, and what did it read? I'd rather see that answered before we vote on anyone.

I am the hidden trailseer, player_10. Tracking player_7 has shown only the night-2 visit to player_8, which fits player_7's check claim. Next I will test player_7's night-3 check on player_5 against the morning report and keep my own track results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them. player_8 remains the main contradiction to watch.

player_7, you said your last check goes on player_5, but that was night 3 and you haven't said what it came back as. Tell us the result and which night it was. Your night-2 check on player_8 is the thing player_8 can test against, so answer that too.

I am the hidden trailseer. Player_7's night-3 check claim on player_5 is untested; player_7 needs to say what the check returned. Player_8 is the one to test against player_7's account. Keep my track results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them.

player_7, you said your last check goes on player_5 on night 3, but player_5 died that night. Did that check actually happen, or was it held or blocked? And player_8 says you checked them on night 1 while you say it was player_10. Which night and target is it?

I am the hidden trailseer. My night-2 track showed player_7 targeting player_8, which fits a check claim, but my night-3 track showed player_7 targeting no one, so the announced night-3 check on player_5 did not happen or was blocked. I will keep my results private and press player_7 on that night and on player_8's night-1 account. Player_8 is still a suspect for the conflicting account.
My vote for now is player_1. player_3 was killed by the wolves on night 4, and player_1 was active that night, so that is my main read. player_6 and player_8, what did you do on night 4?

I am the trailseer. My night-4 track on player_1 lines up with the wolves' kill on player_3, so player_1 is my top read. I'll keep my track private for now, vote player_1 unless new evidence appears, and press player_6 and player_8 on what they did on night 4.

I'd vote player_1 for now. They haven't said what they did on nights 3 or 4, and player_3 died to the wolves that night. player_6, what did you do on nights 3 and 4? player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, so which night did you hear that from player_7 and what did you do yourself?

I am the trailseer and have not claimed. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_3's sentinel report matches my night 2 follow, so I treat it as likely genuine. I will keep my track on player_1 private for now and push the players who have not explained their nights.
I'm player_10, the trailseer, and I'm claiming it now. On night 4 I tracked player_1 and they targeted player_3, who was killed by the wolves that night. player_1, what did you do on night 4?

I am the trailseer and I now claim it because the night 4 track on player_1 points at a wolf. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_3's sentinel report matched my night 2 visit. Next I want player_1 pressed on the night 4 kill, and I'll test player_6 and player_8 by watching who they target.

I'm the trailseer. Last night I tracked player_1 and they targeted player_3, who the wolves killed. The only living wolf is the chanteuse, and that fits them carrying the kill. I'd vote player_1 today. player_1, who did you target on nights 1 to 3, and what did you do?

I am the trailseer. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_3's sentinel report matched my night-2 follow, so I trust it. The night-4 visit on player_3 points at player_1 as the living wolf carrier, so I'll push that and test player_6 and player_8 next.

I'm the trailseer, and I tracked player_1 on night 4. They targeted player_3, who was killed by the wolves that night. That makes player_1 my top suspect, so player_1 should explain what they did. I'd vote player_1 today unless someone shows a better reason.

I am the trailseer and have tracked player_7 on nights 2 and 3, and player_1 on night 4 (player_1 targeted player_3, who died to the wolves). I now think player_1 is the most likely chanteuse. I will share my track results and vote on the strongest contradiction, and I will watch player_6 and player_8 for a role claim.

Open floor from me: I'd vote player_6 today. They have made no role claim and I can't tie any night action to them. player_8, you say you placed no sigil on nights 1 to 4, so name the nights you kept it and what you did with it.

Both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is one of player_6 and player_8. I am town and hold my track results privately unless asked. I will vote for the player with no claim unless player_8 gives a concrete sigil account that fits the record. Keep comparing player_8's claims with the follows.

My follows so far: player_6 targeted no one on night 5, and player_1 targeted player_3 on night 4, which fits a sigil claim but not proof of one. I'd vote player_6 if a vote were held now, since they have made no role claim and the Necromancer is one of the two of them. player_6, what did you do on nights 3 to 5?

I am the Trailseer and the only verified town survivor besides player_8. Remaining unknowns are player_6 and player_8, one of whom is likely the Necromancer. My follows on player_6 and player_8 are the only tests I have, so share them when asked and watch for a night attack through a dead body.

I followed player_6 on night 5 and they targeted no one. I'd like player_6 to say what they did on nights 1 to 5. player_8, if you are the sigilist, a sigil placed on a non-attacker should show no effect, so it's worth naming which night you held one.

Only player_8 and player_6 remain unknown besides me; both wolves are dead, so the threat is the Necromancer. Track player_6 tonight and compare the follow with any body use. Test player_8's sigil claim against what the morning reports show.

My night 5 track showed player_6 targeting no one, so I have nothing on them yet. player_8 says they placed no sigil on nights 1 to 4, but player_1 says they hit player_3 on night 4. If player_8 is the sigilist, they should say whether they held every night. I'd vote player_8 if we vote now, since their claim has no action behind it.

Only player_6 and player_8 are unverified, and one is the Necromancer. Both wolves are dead, so any further deaths come from the Necromancer through a dead body. Track player_6 again and compare player_8's sigil claim with the follows. Vote on evidence, not on who is quiet.

My follow on player_6 showed no target on night 5, and player_6 has claimed nothing yet. player_8 says they placed no sigil on any night, yet player_1 named a night-4 sigil that my track matches only as a visit. player_8, if you are the sigilist, who did you keep your sigils on for nights 1 to 4?

I am the trailseer and the only confirmed town player I can verify besides player_8. The remaining unknowns are player_6 and player_8, and the Necromancer is one of them. I should keep tracking player_6 and player_8 each night and share follow results when asked, and vote on evidence rather than on talk.

Night 1 track: player_6 targeted player_7; player_6 was then killed, so that track is my only private fact so far. No public claims yet, so reads stay blank. Keep my trailseer role hidden for now and avoid spending the track until a claim or vote gives it a reason. Abstain on any vote without evidence. If a serial killer or wolf claim appears, compare it against the track before committing.

Night 1 I tracked player_6, who was stabbed by the serial killer; I have no result to share yet. Keep my role hidden until a track result is worth spending, and watch who speaks about night 1 targets. Consider a soft claim early on day 3 if I survive with something useful.

Day 2: no speeches yet, so reads are blank. My night 1 track showed player_6 targeted player_7; that is one data point, not a verdict. Keep the trailseer role hidden until a result is worth spending, and watch for claims from others that match the wolf kill and the serial killer's targets. Track whoever claims or hints at a useful role, and vote with a stated reason once there is evidence.

Nothing to vote on yet, so I'm only asking for information. Anyone who tracked or watched last night, say whether you targeted someone and what you got. Player_7 should also say whether they were visited, since that's a fact the rest of us can weigh.

Day 1 gave no reads, so I track only claims and behavior. I tracked player_6 on night 1 and they were stabbed, so my track result is private and I keep my role hidden for now. Watch for a claim that contradicts the morning report, and consider a soft claim only if I get a result worth spending.

Night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7 tonight; player_6 died to the serial killer. Day 2: no reads yet, so stay quiet and watch who pushes hard. Keep my trailseer role hidden until a result is worth spending, and consider a soft claim if I'm attacked.

Since I already claimed trailseer, here is my track. Night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Night 2 I tracked player_9, who targeted player_4. So player_9 did act last night, on player_4. player_7, the dead sentinel targeted you, so what did you get from that?

Player_2 was a speculator, so the lynch was wasted. player_4 pushing to redirect it was suspicious. Test player_9's investigator claim: they visited player_4 on night 2, which fits a real check. Hold a vote until more claims come in, and follow up on player_7 as the target of the dead sentinel.

Sharing my tracks since I'm the trailseer: night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Night 2 I tracked player_9, who targeted player_4. player_9 claimed investigator, so whoever checked player_4 is worth a look. I have no lynch vote yet without more evidence.

Trailseer claim is public, so share my tracks when they help. Night 2 I tracked player_9, who targeted player_4; check whether player_9's investigator claim fits that target. Watch whether player_1, player_5, player_7 and player_8 claim any night actions that conflict with what I saw. Stay low-key and avoid a lynch without evidence.
My night 2 track: player_9 targeted player_4. player_9, if you're the investigator, was that a check on player_4, and what did it say? Nothing else from me yet, and I'm not voting on a hunch today.

Player_2 flipped speculator, so my earlier worry was misplaced. Player_9 claims investigator and I can test that: a check on player_4 fits my night 2 track. Keep my trailseer claim public and push player_9 to say whose check it was and what they learned. Vote on evidence, not on who talks most.

I'm the trailseer. Night 2 I tracked player_9 and they targeted player_4. Night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Player_9 claimed investigator, so ask them who they checked on night 2. A real check is a visit, so that answer tests the claim.

Player_2 was town-aligned, so my earlier worry was wrong and that lynch was wasted. Player_9 claimed investigator and promised a check on player_2, which is now untestable. Watch whether player_9 visits anyone. Keep my trailseer claim public and use my tracks as tests. Don't vote without a stated reason.

Last night I tracked player_9 and they targeted player_4. Player_4 was sigiled after attacking someone, so if player_9's investigator claim is true, that check was on player_4. Anyone who can account for who player_4 went after on night 2 can help narrow this down.

player_9 is dead, so following them is no longer a test. My track shows player_9 targeted player_4 on night 2, which fits an investigator check on player_4 if player_9's claim is true. Player_4 was sigiled after attacking, so the wolves' night-2 action and the sigilist are the leads. Watch who backs or attacks player_9's claim, and keep the trailseer track as public evidence.
player_4, I did not visit you last night. Nobody I could have seen came to your door, and I have no reason to make that up. Why would you name me for a visit that never happened?

Player_1 was a wolf chanteuse killed by player_8's sigil, so one wolf and the necromancer remain. My watch on player_4 was empty. Player_4 is now claiming a visit from me that did not happen, so I will press them on it without revealing my watch. Hold my last watch for a likely night target or a suspicious claimant.
player_4, yes, I watched you last night. The watch showed that no one targeted you, so no one came for you. That is all I can say on it, and it is a bit of a dead end for now.

Sigilist player_8 and investigator player_5 both look town-aligned. Player_4 is probably the trailseer. I answered their visit claim with my watch result, which is empty. Next I want to see who targets player_10 and player_4 at night. Hold my one remaining watch for a likely victim or a suspicious claimant.

player_4, I did not visit you on night 1. My watch on you came back empty, so no one targeted you that night, which doesn't fit your story about me at your door. Players claiming a check or a protect should say who they targeted and what they got, so we can compare.

Player_1 was a wolf killed by sigil; one wolf and the Necromancer remain. My night-1 watch on player_4 was empty, which contradicts player_4's claim that I visited them, so I should not confirm it. Watch the claims of player_5, player_6 and player_8 against night results. Keep my role hidden for now.

I didn't go to your door, player_4. A visit with no kill is not something I'd have done, and nothing about my night involved you. You said you followed me, so tell us what you saw at your door and who else came by.

Player_1 was a wolf struck by sigil, so player_8's sigil claim fits. My watch on player_4 was empty, which contradicts player_4's claim that I visited them. Hold my role unless needed. Watch the claims of player_5 and player_6 against later results. Track whether the Necromancer shows up as a visitor from night 2.

player_4, I did not visit you last night. I watched you and it showed no one targeting you, so whatever you saw was not me. Player_4, if you are telling the truth about a visit, who else was at your door?

I am the sentinel with one watch left; my night 1 watch on player_4 was empty. Player_4 claims I visited them, which my record contradicts; I should say so and test their claim. Player_8's sigil claim matches the record, so the sigilist is likely town. Hold my watch until a clearer target appears.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I have no result to offer. Stay quiet and let claims collide before choosing a cover. Avoid claiming a killing role while its real holder may still be alive. From night 2, favor info-gathering through a dead body over kills, since kills read Suspicious and paint a target.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I have no result to offer. Stay quiet and avoid claims until the town starts expecting results. Pick the safest cover when needed, preferring a role whose holder is unclaimed. From night 2, favor info-gathering through a dead body over kills, since kills read Suspicious and paint a target.

player_4's and player_3's exchange can be tested: a sentinel watch on player_4 would show whether anyone targeted them, so ask whoever holds that role to say what it showed. Also, player_8 and player_6 both reported night-1 actions, and only the sigil's death was announced, so the healer's save was not public, which should make player_6 easy to check later.

Stay quiet as ordinary town and avoid claims until others commit. Use a dead body for information rather than kills from night 2. Pick a cover from the worked-out lines only when results are expected, and avoid claiming a role someone else holds.

Stay quiet and unclaimed while others make their claims. Keep my own night results private and avoid volunteering a role. When a claim is needed, pick the cover that fits my nights and has no living counter-claimant. From night 2, prefer information gathered through a dead body over kills, since kills read Suspicious.

I am the Necromancer, hidden and unclaimed. Stay quiet while others make claims, and avoid kills that read Suspicious. Keep a cover ready (Sentinel or Speculator) for when the town expects results. From night 2, prefer information through a dead body over attacks.

player_8's sigil claim matches the record, so that is one town role confirmed. player_5, your check on player_8 is then a clear result; will you check someone else tonight? player_4, you said player_3 visited you, but a follow only shows where the followed went, so which is it?

Chanteuse dead night 1 by sigil, so player_8 as Sigilist is confirmed by the record. Hold pick until night 2; lean Town. Test player_5's investigator claim and player_4 versus player_3 follow/watch contradiction.

player_4, a follow shows where the followed player went, and a visit shows who came to you, so your two descriptions can't both be your result. Please give your exact night result word for word and say whom you targeted. Until then I'm not reading player_3 as cleared or caught.

Town leads on numbers and the sigil result shows the Sigilist is town-aligned, so I lean toward picking Town by the end of night 2 unless town roles drop fast. Keep speaking like an ordinary player and test claims rather than volunteering my role. No night result yet, so I have nothing to share privately.

player_8's sigil claim matches the record: player_1 was struck by a sigil on night 1. That makes the sigil the one claim we can check against later sigil results. player_4, the visit can be tested. If player_3 did visit you, a sentinel or trailseer watching player_3 tonight would show it, so the test is worth keeping open.

Stay neutral and undeclared; Town looks lightly favoured on numbers. Track which claims the record can confirm, especially the sigil and the visit claim. Pick Town by the end of night 2 unless the town roles drop fast.

Player_8's sigil claim matches the record: player_1 was struck, so the sigil fits. Player_5 and player_6 both gave claims; if player_5 has a check on player_8 that is not suspicious, that is the only Town-side check left to test against player_8's claim. I want player_4 to say whether they actually got a follow result or a visit, since that is the cleanest contradiction on the table.

Night 1 sigil killed a wolf, so Town has a small edge. Player_5 and player_6 are claiming roles that may be verifiable; track checks and protections. Stay unpicked until more evidence; lean Town by night 2.

The player_4 and player_3 exchange is the one to pin down: player_4 said 'visited' then 'followed', and both cannot be the same result. player_5, your check on player_8 is useful, so keep it on the record. Who else has a night result they can confirm?

Chanteuse died night 1 to a sigil, so the sigilist is town-aligned. Town has a claimed investigator, healer and sigilist, and the Necromancer is still possible. Keep watching player_4 and player_3's mismatch and check player_5's claimed check. Pick by end of night 2 unless town roles drop fast.

player_10, I'm not the one who should be voted for the sigil death. A sigil kill on night 1 doesn't point to anyone in particular, and I have no role to offer yet. Pushing a vote on the quiet player before the player_3/player_4 dispute is settled seems premature to me. Who did you find suspicious on night 1 and why?

Night 1 done nothing, no result to offer. The player_3/player_4 clash is the fault line. Stay unclaimed for now and avoid pushing votes on the quiet players. From night 2, consider a dead-body check through player_1's Chanteuse body for cover. Keep my reads short.

player_10, the night-1 kill being a sigil doesn't single out me. Player_8 says they placed it on player_1, so the sigil claim is the thing to test. Player_9's point stands too: player_4 said both 'came to visit me' and 'followed', and that's the mismatch to press.

Night 1 I did nothing and have no result to offer. Stay unclaimed for now and watch the player_3/player_4 clash. From night 2 a dead-body check through player_1's Chanteuse body would read Not suspicious, which gives cover. Keep a low profile and voice only short concrete reads.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so there's no result to give. Pushing a vote on me because the pack's kill was a sigil is a thin read; the sigil on player_1 was a sigilist action, and player_8 has already claimed it. I'd rather see what player_5 and player_6 say about their checks and protections before anyone votes.
Night 1 did nothing, so no result to offer. Stay unclaimed for now and watch the player_3/player_4 clash. Avoid pushing votes early. Keep reads short and concrete.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to give. Pushing the vote onto me on a sigil death that was a wolf's own carry doesn't tell us much. I'd rather see who backs up the player_3/player_4 wording before anyone is hanged.

Night 1 done nothing, no result to offer. Stay unclaimed for now and keep a low profile. The player_3/player_4 clash is the key fault line. Answer direct questions briefly and avoid pushing votes early.

player_10, I'm quiet because I have little to go on yet. Night 1 I did nothing, so I've nothing to share. Your Necromancer logic is a reach: the no-attack night only tells us the pack's target was immune, and any role could be that. I'd rather see player_3 and player_4 settle their follow-versus-watch wording first.

Night 1 no result to offer. Stay low, avoid hard claims. Player_10 is pushing a vote on me as the quiet one; answer calmly and point to the player_3/player_4 contradiction. Watch who pairs with whom and track votes.

player_3 and player_4 contradict each other, and only one of them can be telling the truth. player_4 should name the role that gave the follow result. player_6, your Healer save on player_10 is useful, so keep it open. I'd hold the vote until someone pins the follow/watch claims.

I am the Investigator with one check left. player_8 is cleared of being a wolf and claims the night-1 sigil, which fits the record.
